listing.longDescription: Rigorous health and research workflows with deterministic, auditable source retrieval and explicit access boundaries.
starterPrompts: Use AskRigor to research this question with auditable evidence and explicit access gaps.

releaseNotes: Retrieves canonical AskRigor protocol files with byte-derived version and SHA-256 integrity receipts.
Provides 21 read-only tools for scholarly, trial, DOI, full-text method-audit, and public YouTube source retrieval with explicit provenance and access states.
Preserves pagination, reply reconciliation, rate limits, inaccessible sources, and partial evidence without making clinical conclusions or changing provider data.

Reuses an exact governed study-method audit only after complete current-source read-through and compatibility, freshness, and impact validation; otherwise the existing validator performs a fresh audit.

developerIdentity.note: The owner selected Mayan Roots as AskRigor's business developer identity on 2026-08-30. The signed-in portal readback that day showed Individual verification as Approved, Business verification as Start, and the organization notice as Organization could not be verified; no plugin draft was created. This gate must not be marked complete until the portal approves Mayan Roots and a non-secret approval receipt is retained; see docs/audits/2026-08-30-mayan-roots-publisher-alignment.md.

globalDataResidency.note: Verify in the signed-in portal that the submission project uses global data residency. Current OpenAI MCP review documentation says EU-residency projects cannot submit and must use a global-residency project.

domainVerification.note: Complete the askrigor.com publisher-domain challenge for the selected Mayan Roots developer identity in the signed-in OpenAI portal and retain a non-secret receipt.

scanTools.note: Run Scan Tools against the production MCP endpoint and compare the discovered 21-tool inventory with the committed inventory.

demoRecording.note: Record the bounded reviewer demonstration, upload it to an HTTPS location accepted by the portal, and verify the final URL.

finalPortalReview.note: Review tool annotations, response data, privacy output, listing fields, and policy attestations in the final portal candidate.

submission.note: Submit only after every prerequisite is directly verified and the protected repository candidate is merged.
